title: Promethea: An open, CI-validated OpenMC benchmark of the Molten Salt Reactor Experiment
description: Promethea is an open, primary-source-anchored OpenMC reproduction of the Molten Salt Reactor Experiment (MSRE, ORNL, 1965) criticality benchmark, with deterministic CI, full citation audit against ORNL-TM-0728/730, and machine-verifiable k-effective at multiple cross-section libraries. v0.4.0 extends the toolchain to the two-fluid Molten Salt Breeder Reactor (MSBR, ORNL-4528, 1971).
